question: index_behaviour
message: A hyperstable index (catch rates stay high while the stock declines, e.g. aggregating species or targeting on hotspots) hides depletion. Standardise for targeting (cpueTargeting) and run a hyperstability sensitivity, or down-weight the index.

question: index_behaviour
message: A hyperdepleting index exaggerates declines and gives pessimistic status. Check spatial coverage and gear changes, and run a sensitivity with a non-linear index–biomass relationship.

question: effort_creep
message: Increasing fishing efficiency (new gear, engines, electronics) inflates CPUE. Include vessel and gear covariates in the standardisation, or apply an efficiency-creep correction (e.g. 2% per year) as a sensitivity.
